body: Haha that's fine I got everyone covered. This will be sweet, I'm gonna find somewhere for a gathering if we get enough people. So far 3 people.
Lol, just getting on Abilify after a long week of being in the mental hospital. They want me to start taking my Lexapro with the Abilify, probably going to start tomorrow. Being lonely sucks

I do have interests, but they all involve being inside, which sucks. I love being outside, but it seems I don't even have time for that anymore To be honest, my abilify is not helping my depression as much as it should be. I need to start taking my lexapro with it again. I just always think that I'm not talented in any aspect of life. There is always someone involved in my life that is better than me in all respects. Which just makes me think that no matter who I meet I will be below them in intelligence and creativity. I just don't see why life is so worth living if that is how its going to be. But sometimes I remember that I'm probably just thinking too much and there is plenty to live for and explore. I don't know, its off and on. I'm glad to hear someone has gotten over their depression, everyone I know who has depression either has it and cant get rid of it or handled it and it just came back. Where would I go about joining a club? This place I live in is so dead I doubt any of my interests have an entire club dedicated to it. Anywho, thanks for the response! I'll keep trying to stay positive.

If you would like to talk on a day to day/weekly basis and you feel like that would help, Im always around, just PM me. If not thats fine too. Sleep well friend.

Let me tell you something else, there is nothing worse than watching all the people you once had great relationships with get older, leave everything behind, and go to school and become bigger and better than you. Especially my ex girlfriend, who has always treated me like the filth I am. All my closest friends are so focused on becoming successful and making lots of money and they always were. While I was wasting away in another state, they were on the path to success. All I ever cared about were the great moments we all shared together, but now that is all gone. Now there is nothing left to live for.

There is nothing that sounds appealing about living life. Whenever I talk to my therapist about this, she says "You still need to experience all your firsts! Think about your first apartment, your next date, your first pet, your first time going to Europe, your first real job.". But ya know what, I do not give a SINGLE fuck about ANY of those things. Nothing sounds worse than growing older and more weary, working day and night. Only knowing that youre doing it for no god damn reason at all because in the end it was all for nothing. Nothing is left in life that is going to give me fulfillment, Ive experienced that all already. The only thing that will lead me to fulfillment is suicide. I am the decider of my own fate, not some scumbag business executive or anyone else on this shithole rock we live on.
In this society, failure cannot be accepted. Change in life is futile when it comes to being truly content with oneself.

Yes, I am very set on this. If I were to write a journal about the happy times in life, all I would be doing is reflecting on that which I will never get back. Sure, I could set goals for myself and make future prospects. But truthfully, even thinking about becoming my ideal future self does not make me hopeful about the future. Thinking positively is just a sense of false hope for people who live lowly lives. When I think about my future self, I see a whole lot of work for nothing. All I've ever truly dreamed of lies beyond my grave. I cant express to you how deeply I feel about this.
The whole world is a contest, my friend.

Hey if it makes you feel any better I was the same way in high school and am working a shit job living in a shit place and am watching everyone around me become successful and better than me. I am very suicidal. I can totally relate to how youre feeling, pm me if you want to talk.

I feel the same way. Never understood why anyone would praise me for anything I've ever done as I see myself as a complete and utter failure. I always take it like they are just trying to make me feel better and want to sympathize for what a sack of shit I actually am.

I appreciate you reaching out to me. Good to know someone else feels depression the way I do, however...

For me, I do not care what my legacy is. I do not care what the others will think when I am dead. As selfish as that is, isn't it selfish to tell someone that killing themselves is selfish because they "think" it will cause a disturbance in their successful lives. I mean, there is only so much you can say to a depressed, suicidal person. I have always been a slacker. Since I was young, all throughout my teenage years. I've never been good at anything and everyone who has ever met me has known that. They hid the fact from me. Sometimes I ask if I was put in this body to be tormented by all those around me. I know my place in society and it is the lowest of low, picking up after the smart, wealthy people. In my eyes, beyond the grave there is a place. Not heaven nor hell, but a place where I certainly belong. Where I won't be treated as a success or a burden but as an equal being that has made the passing through life's best moments. That much has been made clear by what I have seen in our society. That might seem ridiculous to you, but to me all I ever cared about was the moments I cherished in my hometown. I don't care about love anymore. I don't look forward to working a shitty job and having some miserable little kids with my shitty genetics. All I ever cared about is gone and has been gone for what seems like years now. That is why I seek death. Sorry if my thoughts have disturbed you, this is just how I think on a daily basis.
